criteria.description: The chamber starts normally with usable first-person movement, gravity, collision, and look control.

Blue and amber controls place and replace portals only on marked compatible surfaces, visibly reject invalid hits, and each linked face shows at least a camera-correct single-layer render-target view that updates with camera motion.
The player traverses both ways between portals on differently oriented surface normals with sensible facing and redirected momentum, without immediate ping-pong re-entry or geometry traps.
The cube can be picked up, visibly carried, released, and actually transported through a portal before it is placed on the weighted switch.
The authored solution requires both portals and cube traversal; cube weight visibly powers a reversible door, and the exit wins only while the switch remains pressed.
Invalid placement, repeated crossings, cube drops, falls, and restart recover without trapping the player or making the cube permanently unreachable.
Valid surfaces, paired portal identity, live portal views, crosshair feedback, cube, switch-to-door connection, and objective are visually legible.
At 390 x 844 move/look, jump, interact, blue portal, and amber portal controls support traversal and cube manipulation without overlap.
